summary:
Completed end-to-end integration of all component modules and database connectivity:
1. Activated Bulk SMS & Parent Communicator (`SmsModule.tsx`) into primary routing (`sms`), sidebar navigation, mobile navigation ribbon, `PortalRoleActionBar.tsx`, and `pageMetadata.ts`.
2. Surfaced the public Landing Page (`LandingPage.tsx`) as the default front door for visitors with an immediate 'Enter School Portal' action button to sign in.
3. Upgraded mobile responsiveness across all devices with touch-friendly navigation, edge-to-edge layouts, and compact card padding.
4. Verified bidirectional cloud sync with Supabase PostgreSQL (`sms_logs`) and local Dexie IndexedDB cache.
